title: Morning, the last before
logline: The morning four days before the final page: the flats, the pup, the dock's end with the mug, the chimney, the bird on a piling, the sun. Everything the final page has, laid out and not yet arranged. Nobody in the chair.

panels.composition: The bay at low tide from the dock: the flats gold, an old three-legged dog on them, a white enamel mug on the dock's plank, the chimney across the bay smoking, the small rainbow bird on a piling, a lawn chair empty at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bay at low tide seen from a dock with gold flats and an old three-legged dog on them, a white enamel mug on the dock plank, a distant smoking chimney, a small rainbow bird on a piling and an empty lawn chair at the frame's edge, no words
